sahneler.metin: Engineers found cracks in the pedestals of London's Hammersmith Bridge.
Suddenly the bridge was closed to all motor traffic.
The pedestals were made of cast iron.
In a heatwave, the cracks worsened.
The bridge was closed to walkers and cyclists too.
Its chains were later wrapped in foil and cooled with air-conditioning.
The goal was to stop further cracking.

aciklama:
Hammersmith Bridge was closed after cracks appeared in its pedestals. The cause: cracking in cast-iron pedestals worsening under heat expansion.
